title: cytisus albus
intro: Cytisus albus, commonly known as White Broom or Adam's Needle, is a flowering shrub native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus albus are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
